project_context.description: A high-conversion, professional yet creative marketing agency website named 'MARKETING MEDIA'. Designed to balance approachability (baby pinks) with authority (dark navy blues). The layout relies on generous spacing, geometric grids (Bento), and crisp contrasts.

surfaces.flat_card: bg-white border border-[#0D2561]/10 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1

motion.scroll_reveal: opacity-0 translate-y-8 (to be triggered via framer-motion or intersection observer)

sections.name: Hero
sections.layout: Min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center
sections.content: H1 Heading in primary_blue, Subheading in dark_blue, 2 CTA Buttons (Primary: dark_blue bg, Secondary: white bg with border). Add a subtle noise texture overlay.

sections.name: Services
sections.content: 6 Cards. Use flat_card surface. Icons (Lucide) in baby_pink bg circles. Left-aligned content.

sections.name: Results/Stats
sections.content: Animated counters (use react-countup or framer-motion). Text in white, numbers highlighted in baby_pink.

sections.name: Process
sections.layout: Horizontal Timeline (Flex row on desktop, col on mobile)
sections.content: 4 Steps. Line connecting steps. Circles for step numbers. Title in primary_blue.

sections.name: Portfolio/Work
sections.content: 6 Image Cards. Container relative, aspect-square or 4:3. Hover state: absolute inset-0 bg-[#0D2561]/80 opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 flex items-center justify-center. Title and 'View Project' text appear on hover.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.content: Cards with soft_pink bg. Avatar image, Name, Role, Quote. Left-aligned text.

sections.name: Why Choose Us
sections.layout: 2x2 Grid with a large Header column (md:grid-cols-2)
sections.content: High contrast. White text. Large Lucide icons. Focus on agency USPs.

sections.name: Contact/CTA
sections.layout: Two columns: Form on left, Contact Info on right
sections.content: Shadcn Form. Input fields for Name, Email, Company, Message. Submit button. Data to be connected to MongoDB backend. Right column: Address, Phone, Email.

sections.name: Footer
sections.content: Col 1: Logo & Brief, Col 2: Quick Links, Col 3: Socials. Huge padding (py-20).

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, forms) must include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'navbar-mobile-menu-toggle', 'hero-primary-cta', 'contact-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion for scroll reveal animations and active section highlighting.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font for headings, enforce Poppins.
The Hero section MUST use the baby pink gradient with #0D2561 and #1A3C8F text for contrast.
Store the contact form data in MongoDB via a FastAPI backend route.
Ensure the layout is entirely responsive (mobile-first approach).
All configuration data (section text, cards, steps) must be stored in a config.js or JSON file so it is 'owner editable'.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Use Shadcn primarily for the Contact form, Testimonial Carousel, and interactive overlays.
